thread:
mira.design: Heads-up 1: pushed a progressive checklist variant to staging. It shows two core steps up-front and reveals advanced steps after users complete them. Preview: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/progressive-checklist :mag_right:
alex_pm: Nice. Primary goal is api-key creation. Secondary is time-to-first-call. Hypothesis: progressive disclosure reduces overwhelm and increases completion.
lee_frontend: Quick QA: collapse/expand works visually but focus flow is wrong. When you reveal more steps focus stays on the toggle, not the first new step. Repro: tab -> toggle -> press enter -> reveal -> tab cycles past the new items.
sam_access: A11y checklist: 1) toggle must be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. 2) on reveal, programmatically move focus to the first revealed actionable element. 3) announce "X more steps revealed" via aria-live politely. 4) ensure skip-to-main still lands before the checklist for keyboard users.
devon_devex: Analytics plan: onboarding.checklist_reveal, onboarding.step_complete, onboarding.api_key_created, onboarding.time_to_first_call. Payload: {user_id, variant, elapsed_ms}. Also count if users dismiss the additional steps.
mira.design: Copy options for the toggle: short strings please: "Show next steps", "Reveal more", "More setup steps". Which is clearest?
alex_pm: "Show next steps" reads explicit. Also consider small SR note: "These steps are optional for advanced integrations".
sam_access: SR note is good. Also avoid color-only status indicators for completed steps. Add an icon and text.
lee_frontend: Implementation note: I'll convert step rows to <button> where appropriate and ensure tab order is linear. Will add a small JS helper to manage focus restore when users collapse. Sketch:
```
const prev = document.activeElement;
revealSteps();
firstNewAction.focus();
collapse(() => prev && prev.focus());
```
qa-bot: QA found a bug in Edge where the reveal animation causes layout reflow that hides the header on small windows. Filing QA-900 with repro and screenshot.
mira.design: Design tweak: when collapsed show a micro-summary of hidden steps like "+3 advanced steps" so users know there's more. Also add a tiny info icon with SR tooltip.
devon_devex: For the experiment, we should run progressive-checklist vs full-checklist vs rail-cta. Track api-key creation lift and sample-open rate. Suggested split 50/30/20.
alex_pm: Agree. Run for 14 days and look at new-user cohort. If a11y issues persist, default to full-checklist.
sam_access: One more nit: set focus-visible styles for high contrast modes and ensure keyboard users see a 3px ring.
lee_frontend: Will implement focus-visible and bump contrast for small text to hit 4.5:1. Also will lazy-load sample manifests inside the revealed section to avoid initial jank.
deploy-bot: New staging deploy: onboard/progressive-checklist @ 2025-06-02T14:05:01Z :white_check_mark:
mira.design: Thanks! I'll update mocks with SR copy and the micro-summary and post in #design-assets. Please review the PR for copy + a11y before we start the experiment. :thumbsup:
